title: Nata's Crazy Dinos
description: Adding some crazy dinosaurs to your world.
body:
![Nata's Crazy Dinos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3b901a3a0a3e7334ee147f141a24026c1df61799.png)
Introducing players to new ancient mobs that can occasionally be found throughout the overworld. Encountering one of these mobs could be a death sentence if not well prepared. 
Currently, the mod has added two entities to the game: the Leaping Laelaps and the Night Feeder Megaraptor.

More information guide can be viewed here: [Nata's Crazy Dinos Information Guide](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YzJacuP1b74QTtjgp0TaUqWr91c6MXL3FfD7CEMuqxg/edit?usp=sharing)

> Planned Entities / Creatures:
> - Antrodemus
> - Nanotyrannus
> - Tyrannosaurus
> - Stenotholus
